net_liquidity.text: Net liquidity is $5.86T, +0.02T over ~3 months: roughly flat — neither pushing markets up nor down.

global_cb.text: Fed + ECB + BoJ hold $17.7T (-0.7% in ~3 months): global liquidity is moving sideways.

m2_yoy.text: US M2 is growing 5.7% per year and accelerating: moderate money growth.

yield_curve.text: The 10Y−2Y spread is 0.25% (10Y−3M: 0.80%): positively sloped — the bond market is not pricing a recession.

hy_oas.text: High-yield spreads are at 2.66%: credit markets are calm — investors see low default risk. Complacency risk if this stays extreme.

dollar.text: DXY is at 100.71 (-0.9% in 3 months): the dollar is range-bound — not a major force either way right now.

cpi.text: Inflation is 3.7% (core: 2.8%) and rising: too hot — keeps the Fed hawkish, which pressures both bonds and risk assets.

unrate.text: Unemployment is 4.1% (+0.0pp off the 12-month low): the labor market is strong — supports spending and earnings.

fedfunds.text: The Fed's policy rate is 3.63% vs 4.96% on the 10Y: long rates sit well above the Fed — markets expect rates to stay high or growth/inflation to run hot.

spx.text: S&P 500 is 8.0% above its 200-day average: in an uptrend — trend-followers stay invested above this line.

nasdaq.text: S&P 500 is 10.8% above its 200-day average: in an uptrend — trend-followers stay invested above this line.

vix.text: VIX is at 14.9: normal — markets are functioning without stress.

gold.text: Gold is $4,381/oz (+14.8% in 1 year): moving with real rates and the dollar, as usual.

oil.text: WTI crude is $107 (+68% in 1 year): an oil spike — acts like a tax on consumers and pushes inflation back up.

btc.text: BTC $86,185 is above the 200-day ($70,675) and above the 200-week ($65,462): bull-market structure intact.

mvrv.text: MVRV is 1.44 (35th percentile since 2022): holders are modestly in profit — historically an accumulation zone.

mayer.text: Mayer Multiple is 1.22 (price ÷ 200-day average): above trend but within normal bull-market range.

rainbow.text: BTC sits -0.7σ from its long-term log growth path: below the long-term trend line — cheap relative to Bitcoin's own history.

realized.text: BTC trades 63% above the realized price ($52,785): the average coin holds large paper gains — fuel for profit-taking.

fng.text: Crypto Fear & Greed is 71/100: greedy — fine in an uptrend, but chasing gets expensive.

stables.text: Stablecoin supply is $312B (-0.2% in 3 months): flat — no fresh inflows, rallies must be funded by rotation.

hashrate.text: Hashrate is at 70% of its all-time high: well below peak — miner capitulation, historically near cycle bottoms.

ethbtc.text: ETH/BTC is 0.0319 (+20.1% in 3 months): ETH is outperforming — risk appetite is broadening beyond Bitcoin (typical mid/late bull phase).

funding.text: BTC funding averages +0.002% per 8h (~+2% annualized): near zero — leverage is balanced.

open_interest.text: BTC open interest ≈ $3.4B (+15% in 30 days): leverage is stable.

long_short.text: 0.95 long accounts per short account on OKX: positioning is balanced.

regime.name: Liquidity tailwind · Risk-on
regime.summary: Central banks are adding liquidity and markets are embracing risk. Historically the most rewarding regime for risk assets — and where crypto has done its best work.
playbook: Historically favored: equities, crypto, high-beta assets
Classic mistake: being under-invested and chasing late
